review_class: manual source conformance; not board evidence

rows.summary: Copies a page by reading from source and programming to destination using a static buffer.
rows.witness: flash.c L374-L404 copies through scratch; flash_program handles XIP transitions

rows.summary: Returns the size of a partition in DEV_BSIZE blocks.
rows.witness: flash.c L549-L562 returns sector count shifted once; machparam.h defines DEV_BSIZE=1024

rows.summary: Closes a UART device by flushing output and closing the tty.
rows.witness: uart.c L231-L243 calls ttywflush and ttyclose; tty.c drains output and clears queues/state; conf.c binds UART d_stop to nullstop

rows.summary: Checks whether the UART receive FIFO is not empty (ready to read data).
rows.witness: uart.h L83-L87 tests FIFO-empty bit clear

rows.summary: Checks whether the microsecond timer is within the critical 800–998 us window for E15 guard.
rows.witness: usb.c L386-L392 checks inclusive 800..998 elapsed since SOF
rows.qualification: The timer-window wording denotes the SOF phase delta; the implementation subtracts usb_sof_us before testing 800..998.

rows.summary: Reads a single character from the USB console by reading from the receive ring.
rows.witness: usb.c L1188-L1200 consumes exactly one ring byte; broad draining claim has no witness

rows.summary: Opens a USB device by allocating a tty structure and initializing its state.
rows.witness: usb.h L103 is a prototype; usb.c L1030-L1063 selects static usbttys[0], configures tty state, and calls ttyopen

rows.summary: Expands the text stream of a packed executable for swapin, using a shared codec workspace when SwapRAM is enabled.
rows.witness: exec_hsaout.c L222-L256 expands packed text for swapin; omitted length/CRC checks are not false claims
machdep.c L997-L1041 clears the supplied memory region; kernel context is usage, not an enforced address restriction

rows.summary: Initializes the swap cursor position in flash by sampling ROSC random bits to find a free sector.
rows.witness: machdep.c L203-L244 selects a flash-swap position with bounded rejection and watchdog scratch publication

promotion: refused: fixed-source contradictions; diagnostic geometry only
